verdict.rationale: Evidence describes Crossmint as a single-vendor proprietary API/platform (wallets, checkout, agent cards) — even where it interoperates with external protocols like x402 or MPP, those are third-party specs Crossmint merely consumes, not evidence that independent parties implement Crossmint's own protocol/platform. No evidence pack item shows any other company or independent implementer building a competing or parallel implementation of Crossmint's infrastructure.
